title: Heat exchanger and extraction shaft hypothesis for the Great Pyramid

tellings.quote: For example, the heat exchanger system that goes around the King's Chamber and above the Grand Gallery, the extraction shaft connected into the Queen's Chamber, which is that shaft leading out of it.

plain: The theory is that the Great Pyramid at Giza worked as a machine, with a heat exchanger running around its upper room, the King's Chamber, and above its long sloping passage, the Grand Gallery, plus an extraction shaft leading out of the lower Queen's Chamber. A researcher named Jeffrey Drum describes this on the show, drawing on work by a researcher named Filippo Biondi. If true, the pyramid would be an energy device rather than a tomb.
